snippet.title: This Sirius Black Scene Was Brutal to Film #movie #acting
snippet.description:
Gary Oldman reveals the hardest scene he ever filmed wasn’t an action scene—it was one of the most emotional moments in Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban. ❄️⚡

As Sirius Black, Oldman had to lie next to a freezing lake for days while filming the scene. The sequence took nearly a week to shoot, and after spending so long lying completely still in the cold, he needed hot water bottles and even a pillow to get through it! 

What looked effortless on screen was actually one of Gary Oldman’s toughest Harry Potter filming experiences.
